rationale: Approved: formatting retryable failure reasons as 'provider_failure: <kind>: <message>' is the only shape that satisfies both TC-2.3's required exhaustion form (reason provider_failure, last error naming empty_output) and the immutable Epic 02 verbatim-copy contract (failTerminal copies the provider reason string as-is). Terminal kinds remain kind-led per the Error Contract. Story 4's TC-3.1 exhaustion assertions must consume this same format — noted for Story 4 verification.
